# Portfolio Skills (30s.design)

> Two open-source skills for AI agents, by Owi, Head of Design at Tuyo. Portfolio Audit reads a design portfolio the way the person hiring does, in a first look of about 30 seconds, and returns what they would understand and the three fixes that matter most. Portfolio Build makes a portfolio that passes that look, from a folder of work, in one of three grids. They rest on one idea, the 30-second theory: nobody spends more than 30 seconds on a portfolio the first time (5 on the first screen, 10 scanning, 15 on one project).

Key facts:

- Install: `npx skills@latest add adrituyo/portfolio-skills`
- Skills: portfolio-audit, portfolio-build
- Rules checked: 17, grouped by the moment a reviewer meets them
- Grids: index, columns, case
- Licence: MIT, free to use
- Author: Owi (Adri Garcia), https://theartofvisual.com
- For: designers, art directors, design leads, illustrators, motion and 3D artists, photographers, design engineers
